description: Preview Markdown, Excel, Word, CSV, PDF and PowerPoint files inside VS Code. Edit CSV and xlsx cells in place. No other extensions required.
command.showPreviewToSide: DocsView: Open Preview to the Side
config.markdown.scrollSync: Synchronize scrolling between the Markdown editor and its preview.
config.csv.delimiter: Delimiter used for CSV files. "auto" detects it from the file content.
config.appearance.theme: Preview theme for Markdown and table views. "editor" uses the colours of the current VS Code theme.
config.appearance.colorScheme: Light or dark appearance of DocsView editors. "auto" follows the VS Code theme.
config.appearance.invertPages: In a dark appearance, show PDF and Word pages with inverted colours.
config.language: Language of the DocsView interface. "auto" follows the VS Code display language.
config.highlightRowColumn: Highlight the row and column of the selected cell in CSV and Excel views, and of the hovered cell in Markdown tables.
